summary: Both previously blocking defects are resolved. (1) Browser-recompute/exit-multiple overclaim: the transcript no longer mentions exit multiples or in-browser recalculation; it says 'retained deterministic cases update transaction outputs and returns'. On-screen copy (frames 08-10) states the controls 'select retained deterministic simulations; they never regenerate math in the browser', and workbench/src/vc.tsx lines 108-109 and 127-133 confirm the Recalculate handler only sets applied growth/policy and looks up a retained sensitivity cell and a retained risk cell; no arithmetic runs client-side. The post-edit working return 36.6% / 4.3x is arithmetically consistent with a retained 30%-growth case ($57M x 1.30^5 x 4.0x exit multiple + $17M cash, 20% ownership on $40M funded = 4.32x). (2) Sub-second Helios pacing: render-demo.mjs lines 170-193 and capture-receipt.json place the before-frame at 59.3s, growth edit at 66.0s, loss-ceiling edit at 69.0s, recalc click at 71.0s, result frame at 71.6s, hold to 77.0s, i.e., 3s / 2s / ~0.6s / 5.4s spacing, aligned with caption cues 15-18 (65-69s 'Alter growth or the loss ceiling', 69-73s 'retained deterministic cases update', 73-77s 'decision record preserves each change'). Financial cross-checks reconcile across frames and both packets: AtlasGrid sources/uses ($219.6M and $250.2M) balance to $0 residual, exit bridge $311.2M - $16.4M + $3.9M = $298.7M, seller-ask MOIC 298.7/132.6 = 2.3x and selected MOIC 298.7/(102+4.5 earnout) = 2.8x, entry 8.10x normalized EBITDA and 2.50x revenue, sensitivity grid $210M/6.5x = 23.3%/2.8x, downside 6.2%/1.3x with $45.6M exit debt, 7.8% below-1.0x with binomial SE 0.85pp; Helios 200/1,000 = 20.00% vs 10.00% ceiling, 56.3%/8.2x milestone returns (326.9/40 = 8.17x), 20.00% Series C fully funded (2,902,757/14,513,788), exit EV $404.4M x 4.0x = $1,617.6M. IC judgment is disciplined: REPRICE with quantitative clearance explicitly not granting approval; HOLD driven openly by the analyst-set catastrophe prior with an unreviewed illustrative policy. Synthetic/no-authority boundaries appear on the landing frame, every case header, both packets, and the close narration. Remaining findings are MEDIUM/LOW refinements that do not change any stated number or claim boundary.

findings.finding: Narration promises the viewer will 'see its meaning, formula, operands, and retained synthetic source', but the lineage frame shows the Calculation and decision chain and Readable source evidence sections collapsed; only the definition, evidence class, and section headings are visible during the 6-second hold.
findings.evidence: review-frames/04-atlasgrid-lineage.png shows accordions '02 Calculation and decision chain +', '03 Readable source evidence (5 granular retained locators) +', '04 Audit metadata +' unexpanded; captions.srt cue 9 (31.0-37.0s); render-demo.mjs lines 136-145 open the dialog and assert the headings but never expand a section.
findings.recommended_change: In the capture script, expand the 'Calculation and decision chain' section (and ideally one source locator) after the dialog opens so the formula and operands are on screen while the narration names them, or soften the narration to 'open any important number to reach its meaning, formula, operands, and retained synthetic source'.

findings.finding: 'Minimum covenant headroom 0.6x' on the AtlasGrid overview and financials screens does not visibly reconcile with the partner packet's leverage workpaper, whose selected-case headroom column bottoms out at 1.38x, because the screen figure is a monthly (month-1) minimum and the packet table is year-end; neither surface labels the granularity.
findings.evidence: review-frames/01-atlasgrid-decision.png footer: 'Sponsor equity at close $102M · minimum covenant headroom 0.6x'; review-frames/04-atlasgrid-lineage.png: 'MINIMUM HEADROOM 0.6x' beneath the 60-bar monthly debt tape; atlasgrid-underwriting-packet-letter.pdf page 1 leverage table: selected headroom 1.38x/2.36x/3.27x/4.12x/4.91x (each equals 5.25x minus year-end leverage). Month-1 leverage $120M / $25.9M LTM EBITDA = 4.63x gives 5.25x - 4.63x = 0.62x, consistent with the on-screen 0.6x, so the numbers are compatible but the basis is inferred, not stated.
findings.recommended_change: Label the on-screen figure as 'minimum monthly covenant headroom' and add a monthly-minimum row (or footnote) to the packet's leverage workpaper so an IC reader can reconcile 0.6x with 1.38x without arithmetic.

findings.finding: Narration says 'changing the entry assumption loads a complete deterministic case', but the film exercises the Seller ask / Selected scenario tabs on the Financials page rather than the $200M/$210M/$220M 'Test the decisive assumption' entry-EV control shown on the Overview at 8s; the claim is true in effect (upfront EV changes $240M to $210M) but the named control is never touched.
findings.evidence: render-demo.mjs lines 124-134 click 'Seller ask' then 'Selected'; review-frames/02 and 03 show the scenario toggle changing UPFRONT EV $240M to $210M; review-frames/01 shows the entry-EV chooser with copy 'Each choice loads a complete precomputed underwriting case'.
findings.recommended_change: Either click the $210M entry-EV chip on the Overview during cue 6 (20.5-24.0s) or reword the narration to 'selecting the restructured entry loads a complete deterministic case'.

findings.finding: The button label 'Recalculate working case' and the change-record text 'Recomputed from retained case ...' use compute language while the panel and narration correctly say retained cases are selected and no math runs in the browser; the behavior is verified correct in source, so this is wording drift, not an overclaim.
findings.evidence: review-frames/10-helios-recomputed-hold.png; workbench/src/vc.tsx line 127-133 (recalculate only sets appliedGrowth/appliedPolicy), line 109 (workingGrowthCell is a lookup in engine.sensitivities.cells), line 108 (selected is a lookup in risk_sensitivity.cells), line 158 (change-record string).
findings.recommended_change: Rename to 'Apply retained case' and 'Selected retained case vc-annual_revenue_growth-1; ... receipt ...' to match the stated boundary exactly.

findings.finding: The Helios loss frequency is entirely catastrophe-state driven (200 catastrophe / 0 continuous loss paths) and equals the selected 20.0% catastrophe prior, yet it is presented with 'MC SE 1.26 pp' (the binomial formula sqrt(0.2*0.8/1000)); if state assignment is stratified to the prior, that SE overstates sampling uncertainty and may suggest the 20% could plausibly fall under the 10% ceiling with more draws.
findings.evidence: review-frames/08-10 result tiles; helios-underwriting-packet-letter.pdf page 2 'Probability below 1.0x: 20.0% (Monte Carlo SE 1.26 pp, 1,000 draws)'; data-contract.ts lines 319-324 only validate that decomposition sums to draws and to the probability, not how catastrophe paths are drawn.
findings.recommended_change: Label the SE as a nominal binomial figure or omit it when all loss paths are catastrophe-state, and state explicitly that the loss test is a direct consequence of the analyst-set catastrophe prior (the overview frame already says this; carry it to the result tile and packet).

findings.finding: The Helios overview holds static from about 46s to 59s (13 seconds with no interaction) and caption cue 12 stretches a seven-word sentence over 6 seconds, which is the slowest stretch of the film.
findings.evidence: capture-receipt.json frame 07 elapsed 45.95s, frame 08 at 59.33s; captions.srt cue 12 (45.0-51.0s) 'Helios applies the same discipline to venture financing.'; render-demo.mjs lines 160-168 take one screenshot then wait until scene end.
findings.recommended_change: During 51-59s, scroll to or emphasize the 'Return hurdle clears ... binding loss test ... still prevent advancement' line and the 20.00% vs 10.00% text so the narration's numbers are visually anchored; optionally shorten scene 12 by 2 seconds and give it to the lineage or controls scenes.

findings.finding: The selected-basis comparison card reads 'Selected · Selected', a duplicated label caused by the scenario name matching the card prefix.
findings.evidence: review-frames/03-atlasgrid-selected.png left card header 'Selected · Selected 23.3% / 2.8x'; the seller-ask frame reads 'Selected · Seller ask'.
findings.recommended_change: Render the card prefix as 'Current basis' or suppress the prefix when the scenario label is 'Selected'.

findings.finding: In the Helios packet, Series C ownership is stated as 13.51% at first close, but the cap-table BASE row ($25M funded) shows 12.94% ownership with no stated basis for the difference (pool refresh timing or exit dilution), which an IC reader may read as an inconsistency.
findings.evidence: helios-underwriting-packet-letter.pdf page 1 terms table 'Series C ownership 13.51% at first close / 20.00% fully funded' (1,814,223 / 13,425,254 = 13.51%); page 2 cap table BASE row 'Funded $25M, Ownership 12.94%'.
findings.recommended_change: Add a basis note to the cap-table ownership column (e.g., 'at exit, after option-pool refresh treated as fully granted') or align the two figures on one basis.

findings.finding: The shipped dist/release-demo/storyboard.json still carries status 'SOURCE_TEMPLATE_READY_RENDER_NOT_RUN' while manifest.json reports 'RENDERED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW', so the rendered bundle contains a stale pre-render status.
findings.recommended_change: Stamp the copied storyboard with a rendered status (or drop the status field from the dist copy) when the manifest is written.

findings.finding: The TTS execution receipt is self-attested from the signed-in ElevenLabs web UI with voice and request identifiers NOT_EXPOSED and api_route_status BLOCKED_LKG_EXPIRED, while the manifest limitation says provider narration is not valid until a governed receipt is present and verified; the receipt is present and honestly scoped but only partially governed.
findings.recommended_change: Either re-render through the API route when the credential is restored so request and voice IDs are captured, or amend the manifest limitation to state that this release's narration receipt is web-UI attested and bound only by audio SHA-256.

limitations: I did not decode the MP4 or the narration audio; review was performed on the exact transcript, captions.srt timing, storyboard, capture receipt, render script, and the 12 review frames (VIDEO_PLUS_TRANSCRIPT mode). Audio-transcript fidelity, audio/video sync, loudness, and any visual artifacts between frames are unverified.

I did not compute any SHA-256 values. The video SHA fd3b692b... and source commit a0ae46c... are bound as supplied and as recorded in dist/release-demo/manifest.json (sha256 and source_commit fields); this is a documentary binding, not independent hashing.

The 12 review frames are Playwright screenshots taken during the capture session (per render-demo.mjs and capture-receipt.json elapsed times), not frames extracted from the final MP4; timing conclusions rely on the receipt and script rather than on the encoded video.

Financial checks are arithmetic cross-checks between displayed values in frames and packets (sources/uses, exit bridge, MOIC, multiples, share counts); I did not re-run the deterministic engine or audit workbench/src/data/cases.json values against the Python engine.

The monthly-versus-annual explanation for the 0.6x vs 1.38x headroom figures is inferred from the numbers (5.25x covenant minus leverage) and was not confirmed against source or the technical appendix.
I did not determine whether catastrophe-state assignment in the retained risk cells is stratified or sampled; the MC SE finding is conditional on that.
No shell commands were run, no files were edited, and no multi-model agreement validation was performed.
